description: Ground-truth manifests for building testable, diagnosable, maintainable, modular, incrementally-buildable Python. Layered for agent consumption.
how_to_use: 1. Always load AGENTS.md (~3k tokens). It carries the non-negotiables and the task router.
2. Load the ONE card in cards/ that matches the task (~2-4k tokens each).
3. Read a reference/ section only when the card points you at it. Never read a whole reference file.
4. Copy config/ artifacts verbatim rather than deriving them.

epistemic_tags.ESTABLISHED: normative and stable in the cited primary source - rely on it
epistemic_tags.VERSION-DEPENDENT: true of the named version only - check yours
epistemic_tags.MEASURED: established by running the tool; the version and command are named - strongest tag for tool behaviour
epistemic_tags.OPEN: no authoritative source; a decision the project must make - surface it, do not improvise silently
epistemic_tags.FLAGGED-SECONDARY: only secondary evidence was found - verify before it becomes load-bearing
epistemic_tags.UNVERIFIED: asserted by a source but not confirmed against a primary page
epistemic_tags.CC-FACT: Claude Code harness mechanics, not language facts
